newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - Intel EPS view raised.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Intel EPS view raised.

text.p: -- Merrill Lynch said it raised its 1998 earnings forecast on Intel Corp to $11.20 a share from a previous range of $10.25 to $10.75 a share.

-- Merrill said the earnings estimate change was a reversal of a move made yesterday. On Tuesday, Merrill said it trimmed its 1998 estimate for Intel to the range of $10.25 to $10.75 a share from $11.00.
-- Merrill said the 1997 estimate remains unchanged at $9.45 a share.
-- Additional details were not immediately available.
